summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for new automated reviews from CodeRabbit and Copilot, and automatically resolve them when they arrive.
summary.outcome: Scheduled a 5-minute cron job to poll for unresolved threads; when 4 new Copilot comments arrived, all were triaged and fixed (3 doc corrections + 1 real bug in recovery.html), tests passed, and changes were committed.

repo: VaultBlobV2 type was removed — vault blob functions now return Uint8Array directly, not a typed VaultBlobV2 object.
The v2 blob format is key-only (ECIES), not key + metadata; METADATA_SCHEMAS.md had stale descriptions conflating the two.
recovery.html uses a separate HKDF derivation path for IPNS names; vault key IPNS and root folder IPNS must be derived independently using different HKDF info constants.
Project is a pnpm monorepo under /Users/michael/Code/cipher-box-phase-20 with separate packages for core, crypto, and web.

code.finding: Encryption table incorrectly described v2 blob as 'ECIES (key) + AES-256-GCM (metadata)' — v2 is key-only.
Referenced VaultBlobV2 type that no longer exists in the codebase.
IPNS table described v2 blob as 'ECIES key + metadata' — should be key-only.
Bug: directRootIpnsName was actually the vault key IPNS name but was being used as the root folder IPNS name for folder traversal — required separate derivation with distinct HKDF info constant.

workflow: The /loop skill wraps CronCreate to schedule recurring prompts; cron jobs auto-expire after 7 days and can be cancelled with CronDelete using the job ID.
GitHub GraphQL API reviewThreads query with isResolved filter is the reliable way to count unresolved PR threads from specific bots.
Replying to review threads uses REST (gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments with --field in_reply_to as integer), while resolving uses GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation.
Load/integration tests fail without a running API server — use targeted package-level tests (pnpm test --filter) to validate fixes without false failures.

friction: GitHub API timed out on one 5-minute polling cycle, causing a missed check — no retry logic in the cron prompt.
recovery.html required multiple iterative reads (6+ passes) to locate the exact variable scope and derivation call site for the IPNS bug fix.
Grep needed multiple passes to confirm VaultBlobV2 removal across the codebase before confidently categorizing the doc comment as stale.
open_items: Cron job cadb6bcb is still running and will continue polling PR #349 every 5 minutes — should be cancelled with CronDelete once PR is merged.
recovery.html HKDF constant and function renaming should be cross-checked against the main app's equivalent derivation logic to ensure parity.
No E2E tests were run despite recovery.html being a user-facing file — Playwright tests were skipped as the change was deemed non-E2E-relevant.
